```{=html}
<style>
/* Clicker (ConceptTest) review questions. Unlike the checkpoint widget, the
   question itself is ordinary Quarto markdown (so math and figures render
   normally); this JS only decorates the option list that's already there.
   Colors use rgba/inherit so it works in both the cosmo and darkly themes. */
.clicker { border: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.35); border-left: 4px solid #4c6ef5;
           border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.8em 1em 0.6em; margin: 1.4em 0; }
.clicker.revealed { border-left-color: #2f9e44; }
.clicker-title { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.6em; }
.clicker .stem { margin-bottom: 0.6em; }
.clicker .opts ul { list-style: none; padding-left: 0; margin: 0.4em 0 0.6em; }
.clicker .opts li { padding: 0.4em 0.7em; margin: 0.3em 0; border: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.4);
           border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
.clicker .opts li:hover, .clicker .opts li:focus { background: rgba(76,110,245,0.12); outline: none; }
.clicker .opts li.wrong { background: rgba(224,49,49,0.14); border-color: #e03131; }
.clicker .opts li.correct { background: rgba(47,158,68,0.18); border-color: #2f9e44; font-weight: 600; }
.clicker .opts li.tempting { border-color: #e03131; border-style: dashed; }
.clicker .opts.letters ul { display: flex; gap: 0.6em; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.clicker .opts.letters li { min-width: 3.2em; text-align: center; margin: 0.3em 0; }
.clicker.revealed .opts li { cursor: default; }
.clicker.revealed .opts li:hover { background: inherit; }
.clicker .opts li.correct:hover { background: rgba(47,158,68,0.18); }
.clicker-ctl { display: flex; gap: 0.6em; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.4em; }
.clicker-ctl button, .clicker-reveal-all button { padding: 0.25em 0.85em; border-radius: 4px;
           border: 1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.6); background: transparent; color: inherit;
           cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85em; }
.clicker-fb { font-size: 0.95em; }
.clicker-fb.no { color: #e67700; }
.clicker-fb.ok { color: #2f9e44; font-weight: 600; }
.clicker-answer { display: none; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(128,128,128,0.5); margin-top: 0.6em; padding-top: 0.6em; }
.clicker.revealed .clicker-answer { display: block; }
.clicker-answer-label { font-weight: 700; color: #2f9e44; margin-bottom: 0.3em; }
.clicker .aside-note { font-size: 0.9em; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.8; }
.clicker img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.clicker-context { border-left: 4px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.4); padding-left: 1em; margin: 1.4em 0; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  var LETTERS = 'abcdefghij';
  function initClicker(el) {
    var answer = (el.dataset.answer || '').trim();
    var tempting = (el.dataset.tempting || '').split(',').map(function (s) { return s.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
    var opts = el.querySelector('.opts');
    if (!opts || !answer) return;
    var lis = opts.querySelectorAll('li');
    var ans = el.querySelector('.clicker-answer');
    var label = null;
    if (ans) {
      label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'clicker-answer-label';
      label.textContent = 'Answer: (' + answer + ')';
      ans.insertBefore(label, ans.firstChild);
    }
    var ctl = document.createElement('div');
    ctl.className = 'clicker-ctl';
    var fb = document.createElement('span');
    fb.className = 'clicker-fb';
    fb.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    var show = document.createElement('button');
    show.type = 'button'; show.textContent = 'Show answer';
    var reset = document.createElement('button');
    reset.type = 'button'; reset.textContent = 'Reset'; reset.style.display = 'none';
    ctl.appendChild(show); ctl.appendChild(reset); ctl.appendChild(fb);
    opts.parentNode.insertBefore(ctl, opts.nextSibling);

    function reveal(picked) {
      el.classList.add('revealed');
      lis.forEach(function (li, i) {
        var L = LETTERS[i];
        if (L === answer) li.classList.add('correct');
        else if (tempting.indexOf(L) >= 0 && L !== picked) li.classList.add('tempting');
      });
      show.style.display = 'none'; reset.style.display = '';
    }
    function pick(i) {
      if (el.classList.contains('revealed')) return;
      var L = LETTERS[i];
      if (L === answer) {
        fb.className = 'clicker-fb ok'; fb.textContent = '✓ Yes.';
        reveal(L);
      } else {
        lis[i].classList.add('wrong');
        fb.className = 'clicker-fb no';
        fb.textContent = 'Not (' + L + ') — talk it over, then try again (or show the answer).';
      }
    }
    lis.forEach(function (li, i) {
      li.setAttribute('role', 'button'); li.tabIndex = 0;
      li.addEventListener('click', function () { pick(i); });
      li.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); pick(i); }
      });
    });
    show.addEventListener('click', function () { fb.textContent = ''; reveal(null); });
    reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
      el.classList.remove('revealed');
      lis.forEach(function (li) { li.classList.remove('wrong', 'correct', 'tempting'); });
      fb.textContent = ''; fb.className = 'clicker-fb';
      show.style.display = ''; reset.style.display = 'none';
    });
    el._reveal = function () { if (!el.classList.contains('revealed')) reveal(null); };
  }
  function revealAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.clicker').forEach(function (el) { if (el._reveal) el._reveal(); });
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.querySelectorAll('.clicker').forEach(initClicker);
    document.querySelectorAll('.clicker-reveal-all').forEach(function (d) {
      var b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.textContent = 'Reveal all answers on this page';
      b.addEventListener('click', revealAll);
      d.appendChild(b);
    });
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', revealAll);
  });
})();
</script>
```
